skill.name: chatcrystal-task-writeback
skill.description: Records durable ChatCrystal task memories after substantive implementation or debugging work. It uses write_task_memory when available, or prepares a structured candidate for manual saving.
skill.summary: Persist durable task outcomes to ChatCrystal or prepare a manual memory candidate.
skill.author: ZengLiangYi

content.value_statement: Useful fixes and decisions often disappear after a task ends. This skill records durable task outcomes in ChatCrystal or prepares a save-ready memory candidate.
actual_capabilities: Identifies completed tasks that produced a durable fix, pitfall, pattern, or decision.
Calls write_task_memory in auto mode when a stable run key and MCP tool are available.
Uses project-scoped memory by default and reserves global scope for explicit manual saves.
Records task context such as goal, branch, touched files, and error signatures.
Emits a structured memory candidate when ChatCrystal Core or the MCP tool is unavailable.
Reports created, merged, or skipped persistence results accurately.
limitations: Automatic persistence requires ChatCrystal Core and MCP access to write_task_memory.
The skill cannot save memory when no stable run or session key exists.
Skip and merge decisions remain inside ChatCrystal Core, not the skill.
Memory content should exclude secrets, credentials, and private customer data.

use_cases.title: Preserve Debugging Lessons
use_cases.description: Save the root cause, resolution, and error signatures after a difficult bug fix.

use_cases.title: Capture Engineering Decisions
use_cases.description: Record a decision that should guide future work in the same project.

use_cases.title: Prepare Manual Memory Candidates
use_cases.description: Produce a save-ready memory candidate when automatic writeback is unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Save a Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request after one completed bug fix.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-writeback after this completed fix. Persist the root cause, resolution, files touched, and error signatures if write_task_memory is available.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Pitfall
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after finding a repeated mistake.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-writeback after this completed task. Create a project-scoped memory for the pitfall we found, and report whether Core created, merged, or skipped it.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Manual Candidate
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request when ChatCrystal Core is unavailable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-writeback in degraded mode. Do not claim a save occurred. Provide a structured memory candidate that I can review later.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Safe Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a larger project workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $chatcrystal-task-writeback for this completed project task. Prefer project scope, avoid secrets, and use global scope only if I explicitly requested it.

output_examples.input: A schema mismatch was fixed after repeated validation failures.
output_examples.output: A project memory is created with the root cause, resolution, affected files, and validation signature.

output_examples.input: ChatCrystal Core is unavailable after the task completes.
output_examples.output: The assistant states that nothing was saved and provides a structured memory candidate for later review.

output_examples.input: Core reports that the proposed memory was skipped.
output_examples.output: The assistant keeps the task result and reports that persistence was skipped without forcing a write.

best_practices: Trigger the skill only after substantive work creates reusable knowledge.
Prefer project-scoped memories unless the user explicitly chooses global scope.
Review memory content for secrets before saving or sharing it.
anti_patterns: Using manual mode as a silent fallback for automatic writeback.
Claiming that a memory was saved when Core or a run key is unavailable.
Forcing persistence after ChatCrystal Core reports a skipped result.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it after meaningful work produces a reusable fix, pitfall, pattern, or decision.

faq.question: Does it save every task automatically?
faq.answer: No. ChatCrystal Core decides whether to create, merge, or skip a memory.

faq.question: What happens without ChatCrystal Core?
faq.answer: The skill should not claim a save. It can provide a structured candidate for later saving.

faq.question: Can it write global memories?
faq.answer: Yes, but only for clearly cross-project knowledge and only in an explicit manual save flow.

faq.question: What information can it record?
faq.answer: It can record the task goal, branch, touched files, error signatures, root cause, and resolution.

faq.question: Should secrets be included?
faq.answer: No. Remove credentials, private customer data, and sensitive paths before saving memory.
